label: SYNTHETIC — NOT REAL MALWARE
title: Obfuscated import-time payload + sourceless bytecode
description: A fabricated sdist where __init__.py imports a new obfuscated module that zlib/Base64-decodes a reverse-shell stub (TEST-NET address) and ships a .pyc with no source. The release tag is missing. A legitimate eval() and Base64 data URI from the repository are kept to demonstrate false-positive avoidance.
